A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Neural Slot Interpreters study. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching material moved from the appendix.

before.justification: V3 reports original retrieval, object-discovery, and few-shot classification experiments, plus object-detection experiments in Appendix E.

after.justification: V4 retains those original experiments and adds GroundingDINO retrieval results and a property-type retrieval analysis.

M1.justification: The scene/schema encoders, primitive-to-slot assignment, contrastive and reconstruction objectives, and Appendix E detector remain unchanged. Renaming visXML as a nested schema and expanding backbone explanations do not establish a changed method.

E1.justification: The dataset suite is retained. Appendix D.1.7 adds MOVi-C retrieval scenarios with category/size-only queries and position/bounding-box-only queries, changing the information available for retrieving scenes.

E2.justification: Section 5.2.1 and Figure 5 add GroundingDINO to the retrieval comparisons on CLEVrTex, MOVi-C, and MS-COCO. The existing comparators remain, including those in the appendix experiments.

E3.justification: Appendix D.1.7 introduces controlled training of NSI and BBox QKV on separate property subsets, evaluated with Recall@5. Existing splits, hyperparameter tables, and principal evaluation metrics are retained; expanded setup descriptions do not establish reruns.

E4.justification: The new property-type ablation tests whether retrieval depends on positional information or other object semantics. It supplements the retained slot-count, annotation-count, property-removal, transfer, and qualitative analyses.

E5.justification: The existing five-seed standard-deviation reporting is retained in the retrieval, classification, object-discovery, and detection results. New Table 6 reports point estimates without introducing a new uncertainty-estimation procedure.

E6.justification: Figure 5 adds GroundingDINO results. New Table 6 reports non-positional Recall@5 of 58.51% for NSI versus 38.25% for BBox QKV, and positional Recall@5 of 43.73% versus 45.53%. These are additional conditions; retained results are unchanged.

T1.justification: The NSI scoring equations, mutual-information argument, and Appendix E mathematics are retained. Section 3.1 explicitly describes the standard GRU update within existing slot attention, expanding background explanation without introducing new theoretical reasoning.

C1.justification: The introduction narrows its central question from compositional abstractions for grounding and reasoning to grounding object semantics in scenes. It also replaces the compositionality-preservation framing with object discovery and emphasizes downstream performance. The principal NSI contributions remain.

C2.justification: Appendix D.1.7 adds the interpretation that BBox QKV depends more on positional information, whereas NSI benefits more from non-positional semantics. Its position-only results qualify the broader comparison. Section 5.2.1 also explicitly acknowledges language-based grounding's effectiveness for broad categories.

D1.justification: V4 newly specifies averaging DINO features inside ground-truth bounding boxes, upsampling slot masks to image resolution, and using GroundingDINO similarity outputs for retrieval. Existing dataset-split and hyperparameter information remains available.

R1.justification: Related work adds focused discussion of unsupervised slot identifiability, contrastive object discovery, and optimal-transport slot attention, distinguishing these from annotation-driven semantic grounding. GroundingDINO is added, while the program-induction analogy and its associated references are removed.

P1.justification: V4 consistently replaces visXML terminology, expands preliminaries, and reorganizes experimental descriptions into setup, baseline, and metric passages. The overall narrative and section order remain recognizable. Moving the encoder descriptions leaves an empty Appendix B heading and introductory sentence.

P2.justification: Figure 4 combines the earlier appendix encoder diagrams with the similarity/objective diagram. Figure 5 is redrawn with GroundingDINO bars, revised colors, and clearer shading explanations. A new property-type results table is added; most other displays are retained.

improvement.justification: The GroundingDINO comparison and property-type ablation strengthen empirical scrutiny, including a position-only condition favoring BBox QKV. Clearer experimental descriptions and the consolidated method diagram improve accessibility. These gains outweigh minor editorial residue from relocation, but remain limited because the central method and most results are unchanged.
